split: Same fixed split as the chatcli packs (sha1 of the question id). Claude Code was never tuned on either half; chatcli was tuned on the development half only.
compared_with: results/2026-11-22 (chatcli v1.232.0, same day, same dataset, model and judge)
note: Comparison run, not a chatcli run. Claude Code has no store of past conversations, so each question's history is plain transcript files in sessions/ of an empty working directory and the prompt says where they are and states the question date. The judge is the one of the chatcli packs: official prompts, claude-sonnet-5-5, run through the chatcli v1.232.0 binary (judge_binary_sha256). One run; its transcripts were not read.
